open_points.subject: Project identity outside production
open_points.text: “its identity `project_id`, minted by production Registry at creation or kept by the import (R0-44)”
open_points.question: Who supplies or mints a Project’s identity when a project is created in a test instance: that Registry, or the caller under the residual R0-07 rule?
options: The test Registry mints every `project_id` it creates
Test instances use another stated identity rule
open_points.default_guess: Have every Registry instance mint project identities for ordinary creates; preserve supplied identities only through import.

open_points.subject: Anonymised imported archived Project
open_points.text: “A record the import brings in keeps ... a project's ... archived instants”; “after anonymisation ... every instant [is] gone; when it was archived ... the audit log says”; “the import, as one entry whose subject is the migration closure”
open_points.question: Where is the archived instant of a project imported already archived kept after that project is anonymised, given that the Project loses the instant and the single import AuditEntry does not record a per-project archival event?
options: Retain the archived instant on an anonymised Project
Write a per-project archival audit fact during import
Add imported projects and their archived instants to the import AuditEntry
Permit the archived instant to be lost
open_points.default_guess: Write a durable per-project audit fact during import preserving the source archived instant.

open_points.subject: AuditEntry creation policy
open_points.text: State 0 says “Registry records only significant changes of state” and “Ordinary reads, agent calls ... are not recorded”; M09 says “whether refused attempts are recorded is settled in State 2” and “Whether refused attempts and agent-authority reads leave an entry is State 2's”
open_points.question: Can refused attempts or agent-authority reads create AuditEntries, or are AuditEntries limited to the accepted significant state changes enumerated in State 0?
options: Only accepted significant state changes create entries
Selected refused attempts also create entries
Selected agent-authority reads or other agent calls also create entries
open_points.default_guess: Only accepted significant state changes create AuditEntries; refused attempts and reads create none.
